app.tagline: Plastic tubs, jars and containers looking for a second life.
app.tagline_local: Plastic tubs, jars and containers looking for a second life — in {region} and beyond.
home.beta_intro: We're an early beta — looking for people with containers to give away, and people who want them. Every jar or tub reused is one that didn't need to be made from scratch, and one less that lingers in a landfill for centuries.
home.empty: Nothing here yet. Be the first to post.
home.empty_search: No matches. Try a different word.
map.title: Map
map.hint: Pins show an approximate area, never an exact address.
listing.new.title: Post containers
listing.new.photo_hint: One clear photo helps most. Images are shrunk automatically.
listing.title: What are they?
listing.body_placeholder: Anything useful: sizes, condition, pickup times.
listing.price_placeholder: e.g. free, $5, 500 KSh, trade for basil starts
listing.location_pick: Or tap the map to mark roughly where they are.
listing.location_denied: No location from your browser — tap the map instead.
listing.location_privacy: Your pin is shifted a few hundred metres on purpose. Your exact location is never stored.
listing.seed_banner: This is a sample listing, planted to show what an active site looks like. It isn't real, and nobody is on the other end of it.
listing.error.title_required: Please give the listing a short title.
listing.error.image.too_large: That image is too big. Please pick one under 8 MB.
listing.error.image.not_an_image: That file could not be read as an image.
listing.error.image.unsupported_format: That image format is not supported.
listing.error.image.storage_failed: We could not save that photo just now. Please try again, or post without a photo.
safety.disclaimer: Clean containers thoroughly before reuse. Use your own judgement about what is safe for storing food.
contact.title: Message the person who posted this
contact.intro: They will see your message in their inbox. Neither of you sees the other's contact details.
contact.sent: Message sent. Check your inbox for a reply.
contact.login_required: Log in to send a message.
report.title: Report this listing
report.done: Thank you. We will take a look.
feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.intro: We're in beta and building this in the open. Tell us what's confusing, broken, or missing — a maintainer reads every message.
feedback.contact_email_hint: Only if you'd like a reply. Never shown to anyone.
feedback.sent: Thanks — a real person will read this.
inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.no_listings: You have not posted anything yet.
auth.display_name_hint: Shown next to your listings. Leave blank and we will pick one for you — you can change it later.
auth.email_hint: How you log in, and how we tell you someone messaged you. Never shown to anyone.
auth.privacy_note: Your email is never displayed on the site. People contact you through a form, so nobody sees your address.
auth.error.email_invalid: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.name_chars: Display name cannot contain an @ symbol.
auth.error.email_taken: There is already an account with that email.
auth.error.password_length: Password must be at least 10 characters.
auth.verify_invalid_body: It may have expired, or already been used. Log in and we can send a new one.
auth.forgot_sent_body: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. It expires in an hour.
auth.reset_invalid_body: That link did not work. It may have expired, or already been used — request a new one.
auth.verify_banner: Verify your email to post listings or message people.
auth.verify_resent: Verification email sent — check your inbox.
listing.new.verify_required: Verify your email before you can post a listing. Check your inbox for the link, or use the button above to resend it.
contact.verify_required: Verify your email before you can message someone. Check your inbox for the link, or use the button above to resend it.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.404: We could not find that page.
